freeze_timing: Prepared and committed while 0/3072 branch results existed.

selection_frozen_before_outcomes.eligible_state: All eight candidates complete and contain at least one terminal success and one terminal failure.
selection_frozen_before_outcomes.state_per_source: Choose the eligible group with the smallest group_id, equivalent to the first eligible distance in frozen order 3,5,7,9.
selection_frozen_before_outcomes.pair_within_state: Choose the smallest successful candidate id and smallest failed candidate id.
selection_frozen_before_outcomes.sources_if_more_than_20: Within each suite choose the 20 eligible sources with smallest source_id.
selection_frozen_before_outcomes.independence: At most one state and one pair per successful C60 parent source.

data_gate.required: At least 20 eligible independent sources in every suite.
data_gate.pass: Write exactly 20 pairs per suite and permit the separately frozen read-only C65 score.
data_gate.fail: Write the per-suite coverage gap and forbid every model score.

claim_boundary: Collection outcomes establish pair eligibility only. They are not a policy comparison, model score, or best-of-N result.
